# IFRS9Pro

IFRS9Pro is a web-based IFRS 9 impairment automation platform for banks, microfinance institutions, SACCOs, credit unions, and lending teams.

## Product Summary

IFRS9Pro helps finance and credit risk teams automate expected credit loss workflows, loan portfolio analysis, data quality review, BoG impairment calculations, and audit-ready reporting.

## Key Capabilities

- IFRS 9 expected credit loss calculation support
- PD, LGD, EAD, and ECL workflow support
- BoG/local impairment calculation support
- Loan portfolio creation and management
- Excel-based loan, customer, collateral, and guarantee data import
- Column mapping from uploaded files to expected model fields
- Data quality issue review, comments, and approvals
- Audit-ready report generation and report downloads
- Admin access request, team, billing, and subscription management

## Audience

IFRS9Pro is designed for banks, microfinance institutions, SACCOs, credit unions, finance teams, risk teams, auditors, and compliance teams that need repeatable IFRS 9 impairment calculations and reports.
